20261122-physics-e6-1.material: [Application ti kota] Tongana a bâ lettre ti journal na loupe (lentille convexe) na a mû ni kâ mingi, lettre ayeke kota na na lege nzoni, me tongana a mû ni kpe, lettre ayeke renversée. Ngbele wa lettre ayeke na lege nzoni tongana a mû ni kâ?
20261122-physics-e6-1.thinking.0: Tongana a bâ lettre ti journal
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.prompt: [Application ti kota] Tongana a bâ lettre ti journal na loupe (lentille convexe) na a mû ni kâ mingi, lettre ayeke kota na na lege nzoni, me tongana a mû ni kpe, lettre ayeke renversée. Ngbele wa lettre ayeke na lege nzoni tongana a mû ni kâ?
20261122-physics-e6-1.s.s1.explain: Tongana ye ayeke na yâ ti foyer ti lentille convexe, prolongement ti lumière so réfracté ayeke kpe, na ni sala image virtuelle droite ti kota na ye ti nzoni.

20261122-physics-e6-2.title: Ngbele wa e lingbi ti gbu
20261122-physics-e6-2.topic: Ngbele wa e lingbi ti gbu
20261122-physics-e6-2.goal: Apply principles of Ngbele wa e lingbi ti gbu to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-e6-2.material: Ngbele wa e lingbi ti gbu prise ti electricité wala interrupteur ti appareil na main so ayeke mouillé ti ngu pëpe?
20261122-physics-e6-2.thinking.0: Ngbele wa e lingbi ti gbu
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.prompt: Ngbele wa e lingbi ti gbu prise ti electricité wala interrupteur ti appareil na main so ayeke mouillé ti ngu pëpe?
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.explain: Tongana peau ayeke mouillé, résistance électrique ti terê ayeke kete mingi na dizaine ti fois, na courant so ayeke tuer ayeke gue na yâ ti terê atâa tension ayeke kete, na accident ti électrocution ayeke asi.
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.hint.0: Ti ngu pur, ngu ti lâ kue ayeke na électrolyte so ayeke fondu na yâ ti ni.
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.hint.1: Main mouillé ayeke na résistance ti peau so akete mingi, ngbele so courant ayeke gue na lege.
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o0: Ngbele so ion ti minéral so ayeke na yâ ti ngu asala ti electricité ayeke gue na lege, ngbele so danger ti électrocution ayeke kota mingi
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o1: Ngbele so ngu agbi prise na ayeke kangbi glace
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o2: Ngbele so na main so ayeke mouillé aimant asi
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o3: Ngbele so electricité ayeke gbi ngu ti main kue
